usedFor: Blink manages short, trackable links, and “Delete domain” clears out a whole domain when a team is done with it.

bestTemplate.name: “Delete domain” in Blink
bestTemplate.why: It removes a domain and every link on it in one step, which saves tidying links by hand.

watchOut: “Delete domain” also deletes all of that domain's links, so run it only after a check.
